clue.text: Review of Alien not up for discussion

indicators.note: to review is to look back, so the pieces that follow are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: ET is the film alien, short for extraterrestrial
someone not up is still in bed, abed

explanation.surface: A film critic's write-up of Alien is deemed not ready to be discussed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Review of' asks for ETABED to be turned round.
explanation.definitionFit: A debate is a formal discussion of opposing views, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Racket on its fourth shot at Wimbledon

parts.note: a racket is a loud noise, a din

indicators.note: its points back to the word Racket, whose fourth letter is taken

explanation.surface: A tennis player's racket strikes a fourth shot in a Wimbledon rally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Racket' does double service: it gives DIN as a noise, and 'its fourth' takes K, the fourth letter of the word itself.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis a dink is a softly played drop shot that just clears the net.

clue.text: Brew one's drunk with more sediment?

indicators.note: a drink that is drunk goes inside, so the brew swallows the numeral

parts.note: bitter is a British brew of beer
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A beer drinker complains that their pint is cloudier than usual.
explanation.walkthrough: BITTER is the classic British pale ale.
explanation.definitionFit: Something bittier has more bits in it, as a cloudy pint holds more particles; the question mark flags the playful sense.

clue.text: Staggering aft, infirm sailor may grasp it

indicators.note: staggering suggests unsteady movement, so the word aft is jumbled

parts.note: infirm means weak, frail

explanation.surface: A weak sailor lurching about at the stern clutches something to stay upright.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Staggering' rearranges AFT into TAF.
explanation.definitionFit: A taffrail is the rail around a ship's stern, something a seaman might grip for support.

clue.text: Stressed, Edward first needs money on account

indicators.note: on in an across clue means placed after, so the coin follows the account
first says the account-and-money pair comes before the name

parts.note: a cent is a coin, a small sum of money
Ed is a short form of the name Edward

explanation.surface: Edward is anxious because he urgently needs cash put into his bank account.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' says the account-and-coin pair precedes Edward, and 'on' sets the coin after the account in this across entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A stressed syllable is an accented one, so the words are synonyms in speech.

clue.text: Scene shot with vocals is getting better

indicators.note: shot means ruined or broken up, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A film scene is shot with a soundtrack of singing and comes out improved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' looks like filming jargon but is the anagram signal for SCENE plus VOCALS.
explanation.definitionFit: To convalesce is to recover health after illness, so someone convalescing is on the mend.

clue.text: Parrots from city gardens

parts.note: EC is the postal district for the City of London
to garden is to work the soil, so gardens is hoes

explanation.surface: Talking birds found in the city's parks.
explanation.walkthrough: EC is the City of London's postcode; 'gardens' is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To parrot is to repeat mechanically, so it echoes, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Worldly bishop stops youth taking drug

indicators.note: taking means adding the drug to the end
to stop something is to plug it, so the bishop goes inside the youth

parts.note: a youth is a teen
RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A bishop steps in to halt a young person who is on drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: Right Reverend is the formal style of a bishop; 'stops' plugs it into the youth and 'taking' adds the drug at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrene means of the earth, earthly, hence worldly as opposed to heavenly.

clue.text: Forgo alfresco party?

parts.note: a do is a party
alfresco means outdoors, and without is an old word for outside

explanation.surface: Skip the outdoor party, perhaps?
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' in the old sense of 'outside' is what makes alfresco fit.
explanation.definitionFit: To forgo something is to manage in its absence, a phrasal synonym.

clue.text: Brief attack on retreating Yankee

indicators.note: retreating means going back, so the attack and on are read backwards

parts.note: a fit is a sudden attack of illness or temper
Y is Yankee in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A short assault launched against a withdrawing American soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreating' turns FITON into NOTIF.
explanation.definitionFit: To brief someone is to inform them, give them the facts.

clue.text: Where top artists seek inclusion with nude?

parts.note: leading artists hope to be in the RA, the Royal Academy

explanation.surface: An art-world question about life drawing: where do the best painters want to show their nudes?
explanation.walkthrough: The Royal Academy (RA) is London's elite artists' society; its members are Royal Academicians.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in the raw is an idiom for being naked, without any clothes.

clue.text: Rent securing quiet location for theatre work

indicators.note: securing means holding fast, so the hiring wraps round the quiet sign

parts.note: to rent is to hire
P is piano, quiet in music
a placement is a positioning or location

explanation.surface: A theatre company's lease includes a quiet venue for staging plays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'theatre' is the operating theatre, not the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Replacing a worn hip joint is a common surgical operation done in an operating theatre.

clue.text: Legal team's dull spiel axed, no one having turned up

parts.note: prose is dull, prosaic talk
axed means cut

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means read from bottom to top, so no and one are reversed

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: The lawyers' tedious speech was scrapped because nobody showed up.
explanation.walkthrough: 's' stands for 'is'. 'having turned up' makes ION from NOI.
explanation.definitionFit: In court the prosecution is the side of lawyers bringing the case against the accused.

clue.text: Tyrannise driver that's made off with loot

indicators.note: made off suggests a getaway, so the letters are sent scattering

explanation.surface: A getaway driver bullies the gang after escaping with the haul.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made off' scrambles DRIVER and LOOT together.
explanation.definitionFit: To lord it over people is to act domineeringly towards them, an idiom for being a tyrant.

clue.text: Official knowing the ins and outs of court?

definitions.text: Official knowing the ins and outs of court?

parts.words: Official knowing the ins and outs of court?
parts.note: on a tennis court this official rules whether a ball landed in or out

explanation.surface: A legal official expert in every detail of courtroom procedure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ins and outs' is literal: in or out calls along a court's lines.
explanation.definitionFit: A tennis official on the line decides whether each shot falls inside the court's boundaries.

clue.text: Duck from down under about to be introduced to west

indicators.note: in an across clue going west means reading right to left, so the whole is reversed
being introduced to something means going inside it

parts.note: Oz is a nickname for Australia, down under
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An Australian duck is to be brought to the West.
explanation.walkthrough: 'west' reverses the whole after the insertion, giving the cricket score.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a duck is a score of nothing, so it means nought.

clue.text: Malaysian capital invested in less rounded gem

indicators.note: invested in means placed inside, so the capital goes within the leaner word

parts.note: sparer means leaner, less plump
KL is Kuala Lumpur, capital of Malaysia

explanation.surface: Malaysian money is put into a jewel that is less round in shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money but means the city, KL.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparkler is informal slang for a diamond or other glittering gem.

clue.text: Muscles displayed by northern cops

indicators.note: displayed by puts the muscles beside, after, the northern letter

parts.note: abs are abdominal muscles

explanation.surface: Northern police officers showing off their six-packs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cops' is a verb here, not police.
explanation.definitionFit: To cop someone is slang for catching them, and to nab is to arrest.

clue.text: Slowly cooked topside of beef brought up

indicators.note: in a down clue the topside of a word is its first letter

parts.note: brought up means raised, as a child

explanation.surface: A joint of topside beef was served after slow cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: Topside is a cut of beef, but here it means the top letter, B.
explanation.definitionFit: To braise is to cook slowly in a covered pot with little liquid.

clue.text: Observant legatee, say, turning head on parking

indicators.note: on puts the turned word after the parking letter

parts.note: P is the sign for parking

indicators.note: turning head says the first two letters are swapped round, front to back

parts.note: a legatee is an example of a recipient, one who receives a bequest

explanation.surface: An heir who notices things spins round when parking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning head' reverses RE at the front of RECIPIENT to ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A percipient person is perceptive, quick to notice.

clue.text: Held up, rising before editor's dressed

indicators.note: before says the risen word comes ahead of the editor
in a down clue rising means reading from the bottom up

parts.note: borne means carried, held up
ED is the abbreviation for editor; the 's is a link meaning is

explanation.surface: Delayed, the editor gets up and puts on clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Held up' suggests delay but means carried. 'rising' reverses BORNE to ENROB.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrobe is to clothe in a robe, so to be clad or dressed.

clue.text: Elated fellow depressed but well?

parts.note: elated means up, in high spirits
depressed means low

explanation.surface: A cheerful man who is nonetheless feeling down asks if he is well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well' is a noun or verb, as in water welling up.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring wells up, an upward flow of water, so the question mark flags the sense.

clue.text: Philosopher from East eluding Japanese ruler at ground

indicators.note: ground means crushed or milled, so the letters are mixed up
eluding means escaping, so the compass letter goes missing from the fodder

explanation.surface: A thinker hailing from the East evades a Japanese emperor at a stadium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eluding' takes an E from JAPANESE; 'ground' then rearranges what remains with RULER and AT.
explanation.definitionFit: Sartre was the French existentialist thinker who wrote Being and Nothingness.

clue.text: Fragment of early recording instrument

indicators.note: Fragment of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A snippet survives from an old recording of a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A lyre is an ancient stringed instrument like a small harp.

clue.text: Reject plate with large design

parts.note: a disc is a flat round plate
a design is an intention, an aim

explanation.surface: Turn down a dinner plate with a big pattern.
explanation.walkthrough: 'design' is purpose, not pattern.
explanation.definitionFit: To disclaim something is to renounce or refuse it, a synonym for rejecting it.

clue.text: Bachelor cutting gardener's prime plant with deceptive ease

indicators.note: prime means first, so the opening letter of gardener's is taken
cutting means slicing into, so the bachelor goes inside the plant

parts.note: a lily is a flowering plant
B is the abbreviation for Bachelor, as in degrees

explanation.surface: A single man nonchalantly prunes the gardener's best flower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting' is horticultural in the surface but the insertion sign here.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking glibly means talking smoothly but superficially, with an ease that may mislead.

clue.text: Making bequest, final payment withheld?

parts.note: final means the end
money still owing is a payment not yet made

explanation.surface: A will is written, though the last instalment is still held back.
explanation.definitionFit: Endowing means giving money or property to fund an institution, as by a legacy.

clue.text: Leading gear for Arab wedding, we're told

indicators.note: we're told signals that the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: bridal means of a wedding

explanation.surface: An Arab marriage, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arab' is the horse breed, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: A bridle is the headgear with reins by which a horse is led and controlled.
